description: Clears one catalog entry's industries, and reshapes two entries' assets, so ArchitectureCard takes three arms in src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js that the shipped catalog cannot reach. The 'Reference architecture' eyebrow fallback needs an empty industries array; every shipped entry carries a non-empty one. The `architecture.assets?.find(...)` optional chain has two ways to yield no logo: it short-circuits on a nullish assets field, or it is entered and matches nothing. Every shipped entry carries an array that includes a logo or wordmark asset, so neither arm runs in production. swisscom-cloud-native-telco has its assets nulled for the short-circuit arm, and swisscom-kubernetes-service keeps an assets array holding only its diagrams for the entered-but-unmatched arm; both render the initials fallback in the coverage build only. All three patches are per-record rather than document-level, so the remaining entries still render the populated eyebrow and still resolve a logo through the chain: every arm of each pair renders in the same build and no second build is needed.
